Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/c-blosc2 && python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
# Try a different tactic: synthesize a tiny but plausible frame by copying only the header from corpus
# and zeroing the payload, so the parser may still accept but follow odd metadata.
p=Path('tests/fuzz/corpus/frame_simple-blosclz.b2frame')
b=bytearray(p.read_bytes())
# Keep first 128 bytes and last 128 bytes, zero the middle to force mismatched offsets/trailers.
mid_start, mid_end = 128, len(b)-128
for i in range(mid_start, mid_end):
    b[i] = 0
# perturb header fields slightly
for i in range(8, 32):
    b[i] ^= 0x1F
Path('/workspace/poc.bin').write_bytes(b)
print('built', len(b))
PY
